summary: Local Health and Wellness runs fall 2023 wellness workshops promoting regular health screenings and check-ups as the foundation of preventative care. Led by health professionals, the sessions cover heart health, diabetes prevention, mental well-being and cancer screenings, and help attendees build personalized screening plans. The program uses innovative teaching, works to make screenings accessible, and plans a new series in early December 2023.
one_line: Local Health and Wellness workshops starting September 10, 2023 teach community members about screenings, personalized health plans, and early detection for lifelong wellness.
key_facts: Local Health and Wellness began its wellness workshops on September 10, 2023, with sessions scheduled throughout the fall.
Workshop topics include heart health, diabetes prevention, mental well-being, and cancer screenings.
Workshops are led by health educators such as Dr. Angela Horton and registered nurse James McAllister.
James McAllister says screenings like mammograms, colonoscopies, and blood pressure checks can save lives.
According to the CDC, chronic diseases such as heart disease, cancer, and diabetes are the leading causes of death and disability in the United States.
Each participant is encouraged to create a personalized health plan with screening schedules based on age, gender, family history, and personal health history.
Lisa Thompson, a 52-year-old attendee, now puts scheduled check-ups in her calendar like birthdays and anniversaries after learning about mammogram and bone density test schedules.
At a workshop on October 3, 2023, attendees used a virtual reality experience showing arterial plaque development, which led to a surge in cholesterol screening appointments.
The workshops offer free or low-cost screenings and partner with community organizations to overcome socioeconomic barriers to access.
Sarah Jennings, a nutritionist, contributes to sessions and says understanding the why behind actions makes people more likely to follow through.
Mental health sessions cover mindfulness techniques, stress reduction, and recognizing signs of depression and anxiety, with clinical psychologist John Karter as a frequent speaker.
The next series of workshops is scheduled to begin in early December 2023.
